sentences.en: The seesaw was in a shady area of the playground.
sentences.zh: 跷跷板位于操场的一个荫凉区域。

sentences.en: Try as hard as possible to stay away from shady characters!

sentences.en: This website is full of shady advertisements and clickbait!
sentences.zh: 这个网站充满了可疑的广告和诱饵链接！

senses.zh: 背阴的, 阴凉的; 靠不住的, 可疑的
